title: Review polish: a toolbar hint, one extent selector, stale comments
lede: Fixes from the second mock review. The toolbar now always says how to add a Note, because S/M/L only pick a size and the empty-Board hint goes away with the first Note. The Board reads the Notes' extent once per change instead of twice. Two comments that had gone stale and a README line that read as a promise are fixed.

files.question: How does someone find out how to add a Note once the Board has Notes?
files.summary: A muted line after the colour swatches: "Double-click the Board to add a note".
files.owns: The toolbar's layout: name, size buttons, colour swatches and the hint.
files.never: Creating Notes: S/M/L only set the Current size (PR #58).
files.tested: `src/App.browser.test.tsx`: the hint is visible with no Notes and still visible after a double-click adds one.

files.question: What proves the hint stays?
files.summary: A browser test reads the hint before and after a double-click adds a Note, in Chromium and Firefox.
files.owns: The App-level behaviour a reviewer sees: creation, the hints, the Board's size.
files.never: Store logic: that is unit-tested in Node.

files.question: When does the Board re-render for its size?
files.summary: One selector returns the Notes' extent as `{ width, height }`, and `useShallow` compares it field by field.
files.owns: The Board's inline size: the Notes' extent, with CSS making it at least the visible area (ADR 0003).
files.never: Measuring the window: CSS handles that.
files.tested: The existing Board-size tests in `src/App.browser.test.tsx` (growing and shrinking with the far Note) still pass.

scenarios.name: A reviewer with Notes on the Board wants another

steps.title: They look at the toolbar
steps.explain:
The empty-Board hint unmounts with the first Note, and clicking S, M or L only changes the pressed button. Without this line a reviewer might decide creation is broken. It is a `

` with no handlers, so it changes nothing in the Press module. I checked that it fits on one line at 1024×768 in Chromium. I didn't check Firefox or Edge by eye.

run.to: Double-click the Board to add a note

steps.title: The test pins it
steps.explain: It reads the hint before and after a double-click creates a Note, so removing the line, or showing it only on an empty Board, fails.

run.from: the toolbar says how to add a Note

scenarios.name: A Note is typed in or recoloured, and the Board's size doesn't change

steps.title: The Notes store notifies, and the Board's selector runs
steps.explain: Every Notes change runs this selector. Before, two selectors each scanned every Note with `notesExtent`. Now one scan builds `{ width, height }`. `useShallow` keeps the previous object when both fields are equal, so the Board doesn't re-render and the new object isn't a new reference on every change.

notes.title: The hint repeats the empty-Board hint
notes.detail: On an empty Board both say double-click. The empty hint is the big welcome, and the toolbar line is what remains afterwards. Counter-argument: two lines saying nearly the same thing. Hiding the toolbar line while the Board is empty would remove that, but it would add a selector for little gain.

notes.title: Stale comment in `App.tsx`
notes.detail: It said the top bar reads the scroll container to see the visible part of the Board. That stopped being true in PR #58, which removed placement in the visible area. Now it names the actual readers: the Trash zone and a Drag.

omitted.src/components/TopBar.module.css: The hint's style: muted, 12.5 px, on one line.
omitted.README.md: Known limits: the browser-test line now points to the matrix under Setup, and the Firefox-flakiness promise is gone.
omitted.src/StoresContext.ts: Comment only: `useNotes` now names `useShallow` for a selector that builds an object.
